title: Right-fibration mapping spaces, restrictions and fiberwise equivalences
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, Kan complexes, weak homotopy equivalences and internal functor simplicial sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and right fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Fix an arbitrary small simplicial set $S$. For any map $a:Z\to S$ and any right fibration $q:Y\to S$, define $\operatorname{Fun}_{/S}(Z,Y)_m$ to be the maps $Z\times\Delta^m\to Y$ whose composite with $q$ is $a\operatorname{pr}_Z$, with simplex operators by precomposition. This is a Kan complex. For every monomorphism $i:A\hookrightarrow B$ over $S$, restriction
$$\operatorname{Fun}_{/S}(B,Y)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}_{/S}(A,Y)$$
is a Kan fibration. In particular if $T\hookrightarrow S$ is a simplicial subset then restriction to the pullbacks over $T$ is a Kan fibration. If $f:X\to Y$ is a map over $S$ between right fibrations and each map of vertex fibers $f_s:X_s\to Y_s$ is a weak homotopy equivalence, then $f$ has an inverse up to simplicial homotopies over $S$: there is $g:Y\to X$ over $S$, and maps $X\times\Delta^1\to X$ and $Y\times\Delta^1\to Y$ over $S$ with endpoints $(gf,1_X)$ and $(fg,1_Y)$. No quasicategory hypothesis on $S$ and no model structure on $\mathrm{sSet}_{/S}$ is assumed.
